items.headline: Week 9 has the ACC in the spotlight and backup QBs taking over the Big Ten
items.description: It's fitting the ACC is finally in the spotlight after wild weeks in the SEC and Big 12.

items.headline: Maryland offers students shot at free tuition for staying until fourth quarter
items.description: Maryland is offering the chance at free tuition for the 2027 spring semester for students who stay until the fourth quarter of Saturday's game vs. Illinois.

items.headline: Mike Locksley 'at peace' with Maryland firing, open to NFL, college OC jobs
items.description: Coach Mike Locksley says he's "at peace" with his firing by Maryland, telling ESPN that he's open to jobs in the NFL or offensive coordinator duties at a "championship" school.
